name: native private fields and accessors retain callback layout
source: class Counter {#n=1;get value():number{return this.#n;}set value(v:number){this.#n=v;}read():number{return this.#n;}}function main():void {const c=new Counter();const a:any=c;console.log(a.value,a.read(),Object.keys(a).length);a.value=4;console.log(c.read(),a.value);}
